verdict.rationale: Poke is a messaging-based AI assistant. An organization workspace with admin controls is a plausible capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack documents no team or org workspace, member management, role permissions, or org-level data policies. Merging personal accounts and connecting or disconnecting individual integrations are adjacent per-user features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can manage members, permissions, and data policies for my organization's workspace
